| --- | --- | --- |
| Send Your Design on WhatsApp — initial homepage showcase | Existing official WhatsApp flow after existing Terms consent | Prepared generic clothing-design quotation message; manual attach/Send; no private paths or automatic upload; touch/keyboard accessible |
| Same action — Have a Design in Mind card | Same reusable consent/handoff as initial showcase | No second contact number/system; readable compact explanation and optional existing quotation alternative |
| Convenient mobile action | Same reusable flow | Must not obscure menu, consent dialog, inputs, selection review bar or footer; avoid excessive duplicate controls |

| Special Tailoring | Existing `/services/custom-tailoring/special-order/` | Existing independent form/noindex/WhatsApp picture arrangements; no ordinary-suit policy inference |
| Alterations & Repairs | Existing `/services/alterations/` and dedicated request journey | Assess existing garment; service-specific conditions remain |
| Selected approved design WhatsApp | Existing shared selected/design-details handoff | Actual friendly name/public photo or exact detail link; include relevant quantities; complete readable long-message fallback, no silent truncation |
| Continue/request quotation | Existing quotation/fabric/review system | Consent, complete validated payload and explicit submission retained; sharing is not form submission |
| Shop | Existing `/shop/` and eligible product detail routes | Existing stock/price/publication/payment gates unchanged; secondary channel, not removed |
